title: AssignedResource - Data API
description: Represents a service resource who is assigned to a service appointment in Field Service and Lightning Scheduler. Assigned resources appear in the Assigned Resources related list on service appointments. This object is available in API version 38.0 and later.

ActualTravelTime.description: The number of minutes that the service resource needs to travel to the assigned service appointment. You can enter a value with up to two decimal places.

ApptAssistantInfoUrl.description: The URL that contains the status of the mobile worker approaching the service appointment, the Community URL, and the expiry of the URL. Available in version 51.0 and later.

AssignedResourceNumber.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
AssignedResourceNumber.description: An auto-generated number identifying the resource assignment.

EstimatedTravelTime.description: The estimated number of minutes needed for the service resource to travel to the service appointment they’re assigned to. You can enter a value with up to two decimal places.

LocationStatus.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
LocationStatus.description: The status of the mobile worker approaching the service appointment. When the location status changes to one of these values, a status update containing ApptAssistantInfoUrl is sent to the customer. Available in version 51.0 and later. Possible values are: EnRoute LastMile

IsPrimaryResource.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsPrimaryResource.description: Indicates whether the service resource is a primary resource or not. The default value is false. Available in API version 47.0 and later.

ServiceAppointmentId.description: The service appointment that the resource is assigned to. This is a relationship field.

ServiceCrewId.properties: Create, Update, Filter, Group, Sort, Nillable
ServiceCrewId.description: The service crew that the resource is assigned to. Note: Since service resources can represent crews or individuals, appointments are typically assigned to crews in the following way:

ServiceResourceId.description: The resource who is assigned to the service appointment. This is a relationship field.

Transaction.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Transaction.description: The last transaction ID of the scheduling and optimization request that updated this object. The transaction ID is automatically generated and populated by the Enhanced Scheduling and Optimization engine. Available in API version 63.0 and later.

usage: You can assign multiple service resources to a service appointment. Service resources who are assigned to service appointments cannot be deactivated until they are removed from the appointments.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **AssignedResourceChangeEvent (API version 48.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **AssignedResourceHistory(API version 61.0)**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **AssignedResourceFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
